decisions.summary: Wave 5 = the two open E0 rows, then 23 E1 rows of the homestead modules (farm_fixtures, homestead_parts, rolling/bundle+fit, shrines_wells/wells), described as 'the next modules of E1 after the lane law'
decisions.why: Measured on ranking.json at 931839671: the 23 rows sit at positions 187-223, and 55 open E1 rows rank ahead of or between them (142, 147-186, 189-195, 211-216, 220: interactive, labels, overlap, _knobs, castle_civic, city, civic_grounds, fields, houses, land, roll.py). FR-006 makes a wave a contiguous run of the ranking; the plan's premise that these are the next modules is false and no reason for the reorder is recorded. None of the MODE 1 grounds (impossible, implied by the GM, defeats the purpose) is offered.

decisions.summary: The row street's E1 row (0033 vs 0246) waits past wave 5, left at E1, 'read before it is tiered'
decisions.why: The spec already supplies the route for this case: a row found harder than ranked moves down and says so (Assumptions), and a real conflict between two cited pages is a NEEDS-RESEARCH question tiered E4 (Edge Cases). D7 instead leaves the row at E1, ahead in the ranking, and skips it with no tier and no next step; reading two pages is the session's own work, not a reason to defer. Re-tier it in overrides.json with the reason (or fix it in wave 5).

decisions.summary: Verification as wave 4: Inashiro first, the pool through the gate, back-to-back bookends, impl-drift on every touched unit, a held value becomes a found row
Occasions: none (wave 5) - value moves inside existing placing rules
decisions.why: Same reasoning as wave 2's accepted line; each row moves a value within the rule that places the element.

decisions.summary: Wave 4's open lane rows re-tiered: fouls_fabric and span_walkable to E4 (the yard margin is on no page), near_misses to E0 (impl-drift: the 25 ft is in step, only the aim test unclaimed), the track's gap to E3 after the held footpath row
decisions.why: Spec Assumptions (a row found harder moves down and says so), Edge Cases (NEEDS-RESEARCH is E4; a held value waits on a found row) and FR-003's E0 bound (impl-drift says it matches).

decisions.summary: merge.py no longer raises a closed row's tier through its dependencies
decisions.why: Bookkeeping of the ranking; narrows nothing the GM asked. Its mechanism does not do what its comment says (it rewrote three closed rows' tiers), reported in the spec review.
